register.title: Kevin Fang's n^2 - n + F(n) theorem and its inventory at 078789a (no issue)
register.headline: s(n² − n + 1) < n for every n ≥ 15, and n² − n + F(n) squares below side n, from Kevin Fang
register.source_checks: The author reports that three exact checkers accept all 76 inventory certificates, strict: the research repository's squarepack.verify --strict (and its closed form), tools/rectcheck.py, and Evan Daniel's verify_cert.py, unchanged. They share the rational half-angle representation and the separating-axis test but not code. Their verdicts are columns of theorem/inventory.tsv and theorem/best.tsv; no source program ran here.
register.credit: Credit the theorem and its certificates to Kevin Fang (https://github.com/TheSnakeFang/squarepack-certs). The gluing lemma is Arslanov, Mustafin and Shangitbayev's decomposition (Electronic Journal of Combinatorics 28(4), P4.22, 2021); the base packings are Joost de Winter's 211, David Ellsworth's and Tej Stead's 241 and 273, the AMS21 and Ellsworth packings of m^2 - m squares, and the author's own; the rectangles grow from Ellsworth's, Stead's and Francisco Couzo's packings; the certificate format and the pieces' certificates are Evan Daniel's. The search, the verifier and the bundle were written and run with Claude (Anthropic), directed and reviewed by the author.
register.next_rung: Replay the remaining inventory certificates exactly (priced in the packet), check the six rectangles in both dimensions with a first-party rectangle route (W7), and review Lemma 3 and the induction from the retained README and tools/glue.py; ask the author for the note, draft v0.6.
